info.title: minimax/minimax-h3
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "minimax/minimax-h3", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description:
The MiniMax V2 (Hailuo 03) video-generation fields, shared by the v1 `POST /proxy/minimax/v2/video_generation` request body and the Comfy Router input schema for `minimax/minimax-h3`.
`required` here is the ROUTER-SAFE floor: `model` is absent from it because Router writes the path's model into the body after routervalidate.Guard has already validated the caller's bytes. The v1 wrapper `MinimaxV2VideoGenerationRequest` re-adds it -- see the note there for why that route can demand what this one must not.

content.text: A single red maple leaf resting on a plain white background.

aigc_watermark.description: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the output. Defaults to false.

callback_url.description: Optional. URL to receive task state changes after challenge verification.

content.description: Content items driving the generation. Must contain one non-empty text item; optionally add first_frame/last_frame images or reference_* media.

model.description: ID of model. Options: MiniMax-H3. Router callers may omit this field or send null; Router injects the model selected by the request path before provider dispatch.

ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Options: adaptive (default), 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Required and must not be adaptive for text-to-video; ignored (treated as adaptive) for first-frame or last-frame generation.

seed.description: Random seed in [-1, 2^32 - 1]; omitted or -1 is random.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for the MiniMax v2 (Hailuo 03) models: the terminal `MinimaxV2TaskResultResponse` poll document. The operation is submit-and-poll and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task (`task.status: succeeded`) rather than the `{task_id}` handle the underlying submit returns.
The generated video is at `task.content.url`, and `task.content` is only present on a succeeded task. Every other field is MiniMax's own, forwarded unchanged, but that URL is not: the proxy re-hosts the MP4 and answers a Comfy-signed URL valid for 12 hours (falling back to MiniMax's own, shorter-lived link if the re-host fails). Either way it expires, and Router publishes no task-query route to refresh it with, so download promptly rather than storing the link. A failed task carries `task.error` (code and message) instead of `task.content`, and `task.status` also takes the terminal values `failed`, `cancelled` and `expired`.

MinimaxV2ContentItem.description: A single content item in a Minimax V2 video generation request.

audio_url.description: Audio source. Required for audio_url items.

url.description: A publicly reachable URL, an mm_file://{file_id} reference, or a data URI.

image_url.description: Image source. Required for image_url items.

url.description: A publicly reachable URL, an mm_file://{file_id} reference, or a data URI.

role.description: Role of a media item. Options: first_frame, last_frame, reference_image, reference_video, reference_audio, base_video. Keyframe roles and reference_* roles are mutually exclusive within a request; base_video marks the source video of a video regeneration request.

text.description: The prompt text. Exactly one non-empty text item is required per request.

type.description: Content item type. Options: text, image_url, video_url, audio_url.

video_url.description: Video source. Required for video_url items.

url.description: A publicly reachable URL, an mm_file://{file_id} reference, or a data URI.

MinimaxV2TaskResult.description: A Minimax V2 video generation task.

content.description: Generated output; present when status is succeeded.

prompt.description: The enhanced video prompt produced by a succeeded h3_context_ir task.

url.description: Time-limited URL of the generated MP4. Query again for a refreshed URL.

duration.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds.

error.description: Error details when status is failed; carries code and message.

model.description: The model used for the task.

ratio.description: The actual aspect ratio of the generated video.

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video.

status.description: Task status. Options: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, expired.

MinimaxV2TaskResultResponse.description: Response from querying a Minimax V2 video generation task status.
